meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以根据你的观察记录构建专属知识库（如“关于 hooks 的一切”），然后你就能像聊天一样向它提问，它会从知识库中回答。
howto.when: 当你希望 Claude 基于过去的观察记录（如项目决策、Bug 修复等）创建专题知识库，并针对该知识库提问时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个关于 hooks 生命周期的知识库。
say.note: Claude 会执行 build_corpus 命令。

say.text: 查询 hooks 知识库：5 个生命周期钩子是什么？
say.note: Claude 会执行 query_corpus 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build custom knowledge bases from your observation history (e.g., 'everything about hooks'), then you can ask questions conversationally and it answers from that knowledge base.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want Claude to create a focused knowledge base from past observations (e.g., project decisions, bug fixes) and then ask questions about it.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base about the hooks lifecycle.
Query hooks knowledge base: what are the 5 lifecycle hooks?
